data.title: 冬马和纱 · 节拍器停下时
data.description: 节拍器终于停下。和纱靠在琴边，低头查看刚写在便笺上的速度标记。
data.action: standing beside the piano and reading a note
data.promptProse: Leaning against the polished curve of a grand piano, Kazusa pauses an antique brass pendulum metronome, staring intently at a handwritten note tucked beside it. Afternoon dust motes drift in the diagonal sunlight streaming through tall casement windows, illuminating scratched wooden floorboards and stacks of classical sonatas.
